raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 28 txn_ids delivered twice in the same batch, as record_version 1 and 2 with different amounts. silver_transactions has no dedup, so both copies pass through and double-count in gold. Keeping the highest record_version per txn_id resolves this; it assumes the higher version is the correction, since the version column is the only way to tell the copies apart.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
